crossRefs.note: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out…

people.name: Meshelemiah
people.line: A Levite gatekeeper in the time of David.

translations.web: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, valiant men, eighteen.
translations.bsb: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.
translations.kjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
translations.asv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, valiant men, eighteen.
